notes: Improved automatic playback diagnostics for loading interruptions and source access errors, including passive Microsoft Graph and SharePoint observations. Rolling 30-day diagnostic history with a 20 MB total storage limit. Playback settings, audio decoding, scanning and rclone.conf import remain unchanged. This release diagnoses provider restrictions; it does not bypass them. Public APK omits private metadata keys and retains saved registrations. Update without uninstalling.
